title: Mixed day for Smyth as Saints lose in Chicago

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mixed day for Smyth as Saints lose in Chicago
sources.description: Charlie Smyth has a mixed day with the boot as the New Orleans Saints fall to a 21-13 defeat by the Chicago Bears at Soldier Field. kicked two field goals from over 50 yards but they weren't enough for the New Orleans Saints who fell to a 21-13 defeat by the Chicago Bears at Soldier Field.
